since.description: First day of orders to check, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Older invoices that are still open are checked too.

until.description: Last day of orders to check, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Days outstanding are counted up to this day.

company_name.description: How your business is named in collection messages.

grace_days.description: Days past the customer's payment terms before a delivered, unpaid invoice is chased.

max_messages.description: Most collection reminders to draft in one run, highest balance first.
